label: Post-review high-risk confirmation gate
methodology: The unchanged 30-case synthetic corpus runs through the actual authenticity guard, bundled generation service and review resolver with a stubbed provider and forbidden external fetch. Default suggested choices omit the separate high-risk accuracy confirmation; a second diagnostic resolution includes it. This is not a model benchmark, hallucination rate or factuality guarantee.

riskGate.defaultResolution: Unconfirmed suggested or edited wording falls back to the captured original.
riskGate.userOverride: The review UI requires an explicit accuracy checkbox before a flagged proposal can be used.
